_comment: Registry read by scripts/ci/append_only_base_fence.py. Every entry names an
artifact whose committed history is an EXTENSION of its predecessor: rows are
appended, never rewritten, and a published row is evidence that must survive.
The fence compares what a lane is about to push against origin/main and
withholds the family when the push would drop rows main already carries.
jsonl_prefix  - origin/main's bytes must be a prefix of the bytes being
pushed. Strongest available contract and the one the repo
for candidate_ledger.jsonl via its prior_sha256 state receipt.
parquet_rows  - every identity tuple present on origin/main must still be
present in the frame being pushed. Order-independent, because
parquet re-encodes and a positional prefix is not a contract
withhold_paths is the COHERENCE SET: when any member fails, every path here is
restored from origin/main, because a per-file revert leaves the generation

families.why: Two overlapping daily.yml collect jobs each computed the USAspending append-only artifacts from the base each checked out; the later push replaced the earlier one's rows. Measured twice: 2026-08-07 (360 of 720 collection_receipts.jsonl ids swapped, 1fc6d1181e4c -> 08ad4d836d6a) and 2026-08-18 (376 receipts plus 16 award_event_snapshots rows, 59ccb9c774c8 -> 93ab221b81dd), the second orphaning a 26-row candidate_ledger.jsonl issuance batch and reddening ci-pack-6 for the whole fleet.
